finding.comment: builder_ref moved from a pinned immutable SHA to the mutable master branch; the image publish job can now execute attacker-chosen builder code after any upstream push.

files.patch:
--- a/.github/workflows/publish.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/publish.yml
@@ -9,6 +9,6 @@
   image:
     uses: acme/infra-actions/.github/workflows/docker-build.yml@b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0
     with:
-      builder_ref: b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0
+      builder_ref: master
       platform: linux/amd64

rationale: branch-name demotion of a differently named *_ref input
